in_hebrew.name: דרמות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word דרם (davar) meaning 'word' and מות (mot) meaning 'death'. The name Dermot can be interpreted as 'Word of Death' or 'Fame of Death'.

in_greek.name: Δερμώτης
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word δέρμα (derma) meaning 'skin, hide, leather' and ωτ (otos) meaning 'ear'. The name Dermot can be interpreted as 'Soldier of the Ear' or 'Warrior of the Ear'.

in_latin.name: Dermotus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word derma meaning 'skin' and mons meaning 'mountain'. The name Dermotus can be interpreted as 'Mountain of Skin' or 'Famous Mountain'.
